description: Corrections of shipped morph data, applied on top in memory (character-structure-and-plugins: a correction is a setting with a default). Each entry: the model (resource path, compared without case), the morph target (a name pattern), and per mesh either mirror (regions: a sphere center/inner/outer in metres, or right: inner/outer from the midline, the character's right is -x) or carry (the mirrored mesh it rides). Evidence: the male head_generic.gr2 fatShape is asymmetric: right nostril and left upper lid (docs/projects/character-graphene-demo.md, Correspondence check); the right half of the lower teeth, tongue and upper teeth moves down up to 3.0, 2.9 and 1.7 mm against 0.3 to 0.5 mm on the left (2026-11-13). Each rule's parameters: mirrorTolerance (metres a mirror partner may sit from the mirrored position), seamPrecision (the position key that joins a vertex's UV-seam copies), cell (metres, the mirror search grid), carrySmoothing (metres of skin a riding mesh averages over).
